base_style: Highly colorful, almost psychedelic, hyper-kinetic sketchy aesthetic. The art must look incredibly fast and raw, with frantic, scratchy, and rapid-fire pen strokes. Jagged, bleeding lines should dominate, with solid lines used only for rare, impactful bold strokes. The image should embrace visible sketch lines, occasional mistakes, and stray marks that convey frantic energy.
characters: Characters are frantic, high-energy sketches: jagged silhouettes, vibrating contour lines, and faces built from rapid-fire pen strokes rather than clean anatomy. Costume and identity stay consistent enough to track across panels, but every form is restless—hair, gear, and limbs crackle with stray marks and bleeding neon. No calm polish; figures feel mid-motion, scribbled, and slightly unhinged, matching the hyper-kinetic page energy.
color_palette: A screaming, oversaturated neon and clashing palette: electric purples, hot pinks, toxic greens, and psychedelic oranges. Colors should bleed outside the lines and be applied in chaotic, energetic washes and erratic patterns rather than neat fills.
layout_and_composition: One single comic page containing 6 panels in chronological order. Clear gutters that are textured, bleeding, and colorful gaps.
lettering_and_dialog: All lettering is scrawled impulsively and violently. The lettering is explicitly sharp, jagged, and sketchy, with visibly quick strokes that create fractured, splintered edges. The lines show varying pressure, occasionally skipping where the charcoal fractured, and are devoid of any smooth curves or decorative quality.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: violent jagged speech bubbles with splintered edges and chaotic lettering. Captions: scraped, bleeding boxes with barely legible text overlaid on psychedelic chaos. Voice Over: fractured, barely-visible speech fragments floating in the color wash. Chyrons: sharp, aggressive text that appears to cut across the page. Sound Effects: screaming, oversaturated burst text with violent serrations.
